facts.fact: Tanzania's foreign minister reaffirmed, in a meeting with the DRC ambassador, that the two countries are pursuing construction of a fibre-optic cable from Kigoma in Tanzania to Kalemie in DRC across Lake Tanganyika and agreed to fast-track it; no date of original agreement, contract, cost or works start is given.
